lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct white vertical lines of varying thickness. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, approximately 35-45 pixels apart, becoming more condensed and less defined toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th line from the posterior, splitting at mid-torso height. A minor merging of two line segments is visible near the dorsal ridge on the 8th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, and 3 from the posterior exhibit significant fragmentation, appearing as dashed segments rather than continuous lines. Line 11 terminates abruptly mid-flank before reaching the ventral white boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 4 distinct white spots located on the lateral aspect of the left hind haunch, positioned between the rump line and the mid-thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper mid-thigh align horizontally to form a 15-pixel wide semi-connected linear segment.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, high-contrast white crescent-shaped patch is visible at the base of the tail. Two prominent white circular markings are visible on the lateral facial plane below the orbital region.
